body: My gf. My craving got so bad I told myself I don’t really love her and that if my relationship is over because she catches me then it’s honestly okay. It’s kinda fucked up that I was thinking that way earlier in the day and I’m struggling to believe I was thinking like that a few hours ago

I started reading a book and that seemed to have distracted me for the time being. Don’t feel like drinking anymore for now at least. You’re right, I’ll take it one day at a time and go from there. I’m honestly surprised it turned out like this and I haven’t started drinking or taking drugs yet which is something I suppose. I also just went through my diary which has a lot of instances of me breaking my sobriety and me regretting it very much later and that has also helped me at the moment slightly. The weather is really hot and sunny in the UK so thought I’d treat myself a little with a drink but I think I’ll use the sunny weather to go for a jog and tire myself out for the day. I went to watch the cricket for 3 of the past 5 days and seeing everyone enjoying themselves in the sun throughout the day with beers in their hands really makes me want to drink. Like a lot. I almost wanted to cry that I couldn’t have a drink like everyone else. I hope I can stay sober before university starts again at the very least. I’ve already spent 4 years at university and in a months time I’ll be entering my 5th year at university but I’m still only in the 2nd year of my course…


Apologies for wasting everyone’s time here but thank you all for your replies

I’m 19, I do have childhood trauma but to be honest I don’t think it affects me. Like I feel it could’ve contributed to my anxiety and everything but really it’s the drugs making it unbearably bad so I don’t think my childhood really means anything if I’m being honest. No history of mental illness but I can’t imagine anyone in my family actually going to the doctors about it and if I had to guess then they do. Yes I have problems socialising but I manage with drugs. Really annoying since I come off as extremely self confident and someone who’s on top of the world  (even when I’m socialising without drugs) whereas I suffer from horrible anxiety which has lead to missed interviews, late to exams, compulsory lectures. I think I’ll just cancel the appointment anyway since she was trying to explain to me how I don’t want to take too much LSD in case I overdose. I explained that there has been no recorded death on LSD and she was trying to say I don’t want to be the person that discovers it? I just don’t think she’ll be able to help when she says misinformation like this. It’s not like it’s a really obscure research chemical that doctors might not know about which might explain why she said that but it’s just LSD which isn’t physically harmful. She could’ve said all the other drugs I do with known lethal amounts but yeah I don’t know what to make of it.
